Anatomy Ballistics 1.1.0 (Codea)

INSTALL
1. Unzip AnatomyBallistics.codea.zip if needed.
2. Open the Files app on your iPad.
3. Copy the folder named AnatomyBallistics.codea
   into: On My iPad → Codea
4. Open the Codea app — the project appears on the home screen.
5. Tap it → Play (landscape).

CONTROLS
• Drag — red aim reticle
• Double-tap — fire .22 LR (3s cooldown)
• RESET — rebuild body, restart at 40 ft
• NEXT — advance range stage
• Stages: 40→15 ft (5 ft steps), then drywall+wood wall

BUFFERS (Info.plist order)
Main, Vec3, TwentyTwo, Bones, Organs, Stages,
Ballistics, SoftBody, Blood, Anatomy, Camera
